sources.snippet: Summary: This is a major update with improvements to optimization, transmission, and fuel-trading modeling, new UI features that make working with LEAP more focused and productive (e.g., branch filtering and fewer calculations), and a new opt-in remote diagnostics monitoring system that will help us to find and fix problems faster.
